Total 340B savings retained and reinvested into Mount Carmel's charitable mission and Community Health & Well-Being programs (not separately allocated by program)

In calendar year 2025, Mount Carmel St. Ann's retained approximately $2,973,314 in savings under the 340B Drug Pricing Program, measured as the difference between the GPO price and the actual 340B or WAC acquisition price for each purchase (per Macro Helix's net savings report). These savings are reinvested into Mount Carmel's charitable mission and Community Health & Well-Being programs, which extend care beyond the hospital to underserved and vulnerable central Ohio residents, including the programs listed above. The cost of these community programs exceeds the 340B savings retained. System-wide in fiscal year 2025 (July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025), Mount Carmel provided more than $136.1 million in IRS-defined community benefit as part of $282.5 million in total community impact.

Mount Carmel does not maintain 340B program savings in separate, program-specific accounts. The savings shown represent the covered entity's total 340B savings for the reporting period (GPO-price basis); these funds are reinvested into the covered entity's overall charitable mission and community benefit rather than tracked as discrete per-program 340B expenditures. Accordingly, an exact dollar-by-dollar accounting of 340B savings by individual program is not available. The programs identified above, the total savings figure, and the covered entity's documented community benefit together represent its good-faith accounting of how 340B savings are used.
